snippet.title: UG (VR) - Ride Dinosaurs with Friends | Official Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
🦖 PLAY UG, NEW FREE VR GAME. HATCH DINO. FEED, RAISE, PET, TEACH, LOVE, RIDE, FIGHT!
GO ADVENTURE. BATTLE BIG BOSS. RUN AWAY. TRICK FRIEND. LAUGH. MAYBE CRY. 
HOW TO RIDE DINO? MOVE IN GAME WITH HANDS LIKE GORILLA TAG / ANIMAL COMPANY / YEEPS. PUT SADDLE ON DINO WHEN GROWN. GET ON SADDLE, AND MOVE DINO SAME WAY MOVE YOU. BUT NOW MOVE BIG. 

UG NO LONGER EARLY ACCESS. ALL CAN PLAY. 
UG UPDATE THURSDAYS. MORE DINO, MORE ADVENTURE, MORE FUN. 
https://www.ug-vr.com/
